What's new in 1.15

Released on November 2, 2026

This update brings faster Mermaid diagrams that match your theme, reorderable filters in Bases, and new URI and CLI commands for adding content under a heading.

Diagrams and charts

Mermaid diagrams and charts are now rendered using our new library Pele, compatible with the latest Mermaid 12.1.0 syntax.

Diagrams are now responsive to the width of a note, and can be zoomed and panned when they are scaled down.

offline.html:
What's new in 1.15

Released on November 2, 2026

This update brings faster Mermaid diagrams that match your theme, reorderable filters in Bases, and new URI and CLI commands for adding content under a heading.

Diagrams and charts

Mermaid diagrams and charts are now rendered using our new library Pele, compatible with the latest Mermaid 12.1.0 syntax.

  • Diagrams now appear faster and use the colors and fonts of your theme.
  • Diagrams are now responsive to the width of a note, and can be zoomed and panned when they are scaled down.
  • Diagrams are now shown without asking first, since Pele can't run code. The Show Mermaid diagrams in notes setting has been removed.

Improvements

  • URI/CLI: Added commands to append or prepend to a heading, and control for line breaks around appended/prepended content.
  • Suggestions now ignore diacritics (accent marks) so cafe matches café in link suggestions, Quick switcher, Command palette, and Bases search.
  • Tooltips no long
